document.title: R. STAHL Presa da muro, connettore 8570/11, 8570/12
document.pages: pp.5-8 ratings/contact arrangement; pp.10-12 connection/operation; p.14 protective caps

modelingNotes: Exact 200-250 V AC, 50/60 Hz, 16 A, 2P+PE, blue, 6h variant. Capability 250 V is the range upper bound, not a declaration of the connected circuit voltage.

Cable-side terminals and mating contacts are separate authoring endpoints: C.P1/C.P2/C.PE and M.P1/M.P2/M.PE. P1/P2 are neutral functional pole aliases, not verified stamped pin numbers or installation L/N assignments. C/M prefixes identify side, not manufacturer markings. No front-view orientation or universal connector compatibility is asserted.
The PE connection is required. An explicit project jumper must represent the fixed C.PE-M.PE conductor. Connector-port metadata alone never joins nets.

Each plug screw and its matching pin are permanently connected in the hardware. Author three explicit project jumpers (C.P1-M.P1,C.P2-M.P2,C.PE-M.PE); type functions do not manufacture physical continuity.
Installation variants, exact screw/terminal legends, seals and hazardous-area suitability require hardware/manual review. Electrical safety certification is not a compiler result.

Historical 8570/12-306 identification is corroborated by manufacturer 6036 accessory table (article 150579): https://r-stahl.com/fileadmin/tx_aimeos/Files/n_/gb/SDS_PV_227433_en_GB.pdf. Modern same-order articles/revisions are not substituted for the legacy hardware.

connectionCoverage.notes: Two power poles and PE at cable and mating sides are inventoried separately. Functional aliases do not establish physical pin numbering, orientation or all screw positions. No optional accessory contacts are included; fixed internal links need explicit project jumpers.
